# Hollowbrook Roasters

> Hollowbrook Roasters is a small-batch coffee roaster and café in West Asheville, North Carolina, selling single-origin coffees, a flexible coffee subscription and wholesale coffee for cafés.

## Shop

- [Home](https://hollowbrookroasters.com/): Who we are, how we roast and ship, and where to start.
- [Coffees](https://hollowbrookroasters.com/coffees.html): The current lineup of single-origin coffees, house blend and decaf, with prices.
- [Subscription](https://hollowbrookroasters.com/subscription.html): How the coffee subscription works, delivery frequencies, and the sign-up form.
- [Wholesale](https://hollowbrookroasters.com/wholesale.html): Wholesale coffee for cafés, restaurants and offices, with barista training and equipment support.

## Brew guides

- [Brew guides](https://hollowbrookroasters.com/brew-guides/): Tested recipes for brewing Hollowbrook coffee at home.
- [A three-minute V60 pour-over](https://hollowbrookroasters.com/brew-guides/v60-pour-over.html): Our everyday V60 recipe with ratio, grind size, temperature and troubleshooting.
- [Cold brew concentrate](https://hollowbrookroasters.com/brew-guides/cold-brew.html): How to make cold brew concentrate at home, which coffees work best and how long it keeps.

## Visit and contact

- [Visit the café](https://hollowbrookroasters.com/cafe.html): Hours, address and parking for the café and roastery on Haywood Road.
- [About](https://hollowbrookroasters.com/about.html): The story of Hollowbrook, its founders and how we source green coffee.
- [Contact](https://hollowbrookroasters.com/contact.html): How to reach us about an order, a subscription or wholesale.
